title_en: Technology and Engineering (1/20): Choosing a New Computer at the Electronics Store
note_en: 台 (tái) is the measure word for machines and appliances: 一台新电脑 "a new computer," 几台电脑 "several computers." English simply says "a computer," but Chinese can't put a number or 这/那 directly before the noun; notice how 这台 alone (最后决定买这台) even stands in for "this one."
